periods.description: The skill of summoning, linking with, and fighting through ancient mechanical dragon armor using a Sword Device.

details.equipment: Sword Device plus stored Drag-Ride body
details.control: combines physical movement and mental control through the Sword Device

activation.condition: compatible Sword Device, paired Drag-Ride, and user aptitude

effects: summons armor from a hangar by spatial transfer
wraps the user in mechanical dragon armor

power_level.initial: ordinary users can operate general-purpose Drag-Rides
power_level.peak: Divine Drag-Ride users and Lux/Bahamut exceed normal limits

known_feats: girls at the academy summon Wyvern, Wyrm, and Drake types
Lux uses Wyvern and later Bahamut
Lisha uses Tiamat and a custom Chimeric Wyvern
